commercial.title: Commercial & Industrial
commercial.description: Heavy-duty applications built for forklift traffic, harsh chemicals, and rigorous safety protocols in East Texas.

projects.name: Local Auto Repair Shop
projects.description: Installed a high-impact, slip-resistant system designed specifically to withstand dropped tools, jack stands, and harsh automotive solvents. The floor was prepped with a heavy diamond grind.

projects.name: East Texas Manufacturing Facility
projects.description: A 5,000 sq ft warehouse requiring minimal downtime. We used a fast-curing polyaspartic system that allowed them to resume forklift operations within 48 hours.

residential.title: Residential Garages
residential.description: Explore our recent residential garage floor transformations. Every project features our industrial-grade, multi-layer polyaspartic coating system.

projects.name: Lindale 3-Car Garage
projects.description: A complete overhaul of a heavily oil-stained 3-car garage. We ground the concrete down to the pores and applied a custom dark blue flake blend.

projects.name: Tyler Garage Revamp
projects.description: Updated from a peeling 1 coat epoxy to a durable tiered epoxy system. This homeowner opted for a clean, white and grey flake with a durable clear topcoat for easy maintenance.

outdoor.title: Outdoor & Patios
outdoor.description: 100% waterproof and easy-to-wash coatings perfect for patios and outdoor living spaces.

projects.name: Backyard Pool Deck
projects.description: Resurfaced an aging, cracked concrete pool deck using a UV-stable polyaspartic coating with a broadcast quartz additive for maximum grip around wet areas.

projects.name: East Texas Lakefront Patio
projects.description: A seamless, waterproof floor coating that prevents bacteria buildup and makes daily wash-downs incredibly fast and efficient.
